Signals: GPS L1 C/A. Fixed spoofed position: 69.27547832, 15.96832496, 35 m hae. Scenario: One satellite is configured as PRN 37 from the start of the simulation and remains PRN 37 throughout the scenario. This tests receiver behaviour when a reserved PRN is present during acquisition and tracking. The simulated PRN 37 signal will be transmitted with satellite health set to healthy.

Drone "Jammertest" scenario. Signals: GPS L1 C/A, L2C, L5. Galileo E1, E5, E6. Simulated start position: 69.277014014, 15.969328354, 40 m hae. Simulated start time: Referenced to live GPS-signals. Spoofing transmission will be corrected for signal delay to simulated start position. DUTs, such as drones, at start position (victim position) should see coherent signals.
